strategies.name: liquidity_grab_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: Identify a liquidity grab where price briefly breaks support or resistance and then reverses. Enter at the price level of the candle that made the liquidity grab: for longs, at the top of the grab candle after sell-side liquidity is taken; for shorts, at the bottom of the grab candle after buy-side/
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the liquidity grab wick/level. Set the take profit at the most recent opposing swing level: a recent high for longs or a recent low for shorts.

variants.timeframe_note: Works on all timeframes; examples include 15-minute
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use the liquidity-grab candle as the trigger/entry reference
variants.target_note: Take profit at recent swing high/low
variants.transcript_quote: your long entry would be at this point right here because this candle made this liquidity grab
